_source: The native registry of the power-quests-1 bench run (2026-10-25, kubejs-exported/items.json, format gg-items-1): every item, block item and fluid id that LuV B6 (startup_scripts/grindless/luv/io_surface.js and server_scripts/grindless/luv/io_surface.js) uses that is not registered by A1 (startup_scripts/grindless/luv/foundation.js) or added by its materialModification (gtceu:dense_titanium_plate); each one checked to be in that registry.
_how_it_is_used: tools/analysis/test/luv-io-surface.test.mjs checks every id the two scripts use, in recipes and in the patterns, against this list and A1's published ids. Never add an id that is not in a native registry export.
